name: @sprintwire/mcp
stderr:
sprintwire-mcp: missing SPRINTWIRE_URL, SPRINTWIRE_TOKEN, SPRINTWIRE_WORKSPACE_ID.

Add this to claude_desktop_config.json under "mcpServers":

  "sprintwire": {
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@sprintwire/mcp"],
    "env": {
      "SPRINTWIRE_URL": "https://sprintwire.example.com",
      "SPRINTWIRE_TOKEN": "swk_live_…",
      "SPRINTWIRE_WORKSPACE_ID": "…"
    }
  }

If npx cannot find the package, point "command" at "node" and "args" at
your checkout: ["/path/to/sprintwire/apps/mcp/dist/index.js"].

Create the token in Settings → API tokens. It carries your own permissions,
narrowed further because it acts as an agent.
